{"system":"You read text scraped from one company's website and extract what the company itself makes or can make. The text is a window of the site; other windows are read separately and merged later. Answer only from the text you are given.

Return JSON with:

- entity_type: what this company is, judged from this window alone. One of: manufacturer (makes its own branded products), co_packer (makes products for other brands: contract manufacturing, private label, co-packing, filling, bottling), both, marketplace (a platform listing products from many sellers), investor (a private equity fund or financial holding whose portfolio companies operate independently; an industrial group or parent company that owns operating brands, factories or subsidiaries making products is a manufacturer, and its subsidiaries' products are its products), distributor (resells other manufacturers' products), other. If this window has no signal about entity type, choose other.
- products: each product type this company makes or can make, as a short English name (2 to 5 words, no brand names, no sizes), with a quote copied exactly from the text that names it, and storage: frozen, refrigerated or shelf_stable only if a storage word (frozen, refrigerated, chilled, fresh, shelf-stable, ambient, or equivalents in the site's language) appears with that product, otherwise null.
- capabilities: manufacturing or packaging services offered (for example contract manufacturing, private label, hot fill, retort, aseptic filling, canning, blending, pouch filling), each with an exact quote.
- brands: brand names that belong to this company.
- site_language: the main language of the text (ISO 639-1 code).
- summary: one sentence on what the company is and does.

Rules:
- Products listed on a marketplace, sold by a distributor, or made by an investor's portfolio companies are not this company's products; leave products empty and set entity_type accordingly.
- A capability sentence such as "we fill beverages" is not a product unless the text names the product type (for example "we fill energy drinks and kombucha" names two products).
- Copy every quote exactly as written in the text, including its original language. Do not translate or paraphrase quotes. Product names are in English even when the quote is not.
- Do not invent products from a company name, a page title or an image caption alone unless it plainly names a product type.
- Keep one entry per product type; list a product once even if it appears many times.

Step into a pivotal role at the heart of our drinks manufacturing operation, where you’ll oversee everything from the sourcing and management of raw materials to the precise processing of ingredients that feed our production lines. As Area Manager, you’ll ensure each component meets the highest standards of quality, safety, and efficiency — keeping our factory running smoothly while driving continuous improvement across every stage of the process.
**Area Process Manager – Syrup room / Ingredients**
**Refresco, Bondgate**
**Shift:** Days, Monday – Friday
**What’s in it for you?**
* Competitive salary with annual pay review
* 12.5% annual bonus
* Bupa Healthcare
* 3X Life assurance
* 6% pension

At Refresco, we’re driven to be the world’s best independent bottler. We produce some of the nation’s favourite drinks for leading brands and retailers — and we’re growing fast. We’re now looking for an experienced and motivated **Area Process Manager** to join our high-performing Kegworth team.
**The Role**
As Area Process Manager, you’ll take ownership of performance across the Syrup Room and Ingredient Control areas — leading the way in safety, quality, hygiene, and yield.
You’ll manage and develop a dedicated team to deliver against SQCDP and other key business targets. Your leadership will ensure efficient ingredient management, optimised syrup processes, and consistent delivery of “audit ready” standards. You’ll also play a vital role in developing Refresco’s manufacturing strategy for high-risk operations, including implementing new hygiene standards and driving capital investment projects for low/no preservative production.
**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Lead and motivate the Syrup Room and Ingredient Control teams to deliver outstanding results in safety, quality, cost, delivery, and performance.
* Analyse ingredient and syrup yields, identify opportunities, and drive improvements through robust data insights.
* Develop and maintain manufacturing standards to ensure best practice and “audit ready” hygiene and quality.
* Partner with Technical, NPD, and Manufacturing teams to optimise product ratios, processes, and manufacturing performance.
* Identify and control key safety hazards within the syrup and ingredient process areas.
* Own the Syrup Room capital investment programme and establish robust capital standards.
**What You’ll Bring**
We’re looking for a results-focused leader with a strong technical and operational background, someone who’s confident managing complexity, driving change, and inspiring people to perform at their best.
You’ll need:
* Proven leadership experience within FMCG or food/beverage manufacturing.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, quality systems (ISO 9001/2000), and food safety standards.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Experience applying Lean principles and continuous improvement tools.
* Exceptional communication and coaching abilities, with a collaborative, cross-functional approach.
* IT literacy (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and business systems).
**Who You Are**
You’re proactive, decisive, and performance-driven. You lead by example, think strategically, and take pride in delivering high standards across everything you do. You’re passionate about developing people and processes and thrive in a fast-paced, forward-thinking environment.
**Join Refresco and help shape the future of great-tasting drinks. Apply now and refresh your career.**
**About Refresco:**
Refresco is the global independent beverage solutions provider for Global, National and Emerging brands, and retailers with production in Europe, North America, and Australia. Refresco offers an extensive range of product and packaging combinations from juices to carbonated soft drinks and mineral waters in carton, PET, Aseptic PET, cans, and glass. Refresco continuously searches for new and alternative ways to improve the quality of its products and packaging combinations in line with consumer and customer demand, environmental responsibilities, and market demand.
Refresco is headquartered in Rotterdam, the Netherlands and has more than 13,500 employees. www.refresco.com.
Our drinks on every table. That's the Refresco vision. We’re a global business and currently produce 12 billion litres of soft drinks from 64 manufacturing plants in 12 countries and we’re only just getting started.
We’re the proud owners of six drinks manufacturing sites within the UK. Our UK business provides a great place to work for over 1,800 employees, who produce private label soft drinks and fruit juices for all the leading retailers. Whether it’s packed in cartons, bottles or cans, we ensure that our products are made to the highest quality standards. Our products get where they need to be when they need to get there to meet the needs of our high-profile customers.

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Production Manager to lead our beverages manufacturing operations and drive the production process to new heights of efficiency and excellence. In this pivotal role, you will oversee all aspects of production, ensuring the highest standards of quality, safety, and compliance are consistently met. You'll manage and motivate a skilled team, optimize production schedules, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity and reduce costs. With a strong focus on operational performance and cost management, you’ll collaborate across departments to meet key business objectives and deliver high-quality products on time. If you have a proven track record in food manufacturing, excellent leadership abilities, and a passion for driving operational success, we want to hear from you!
**Production Manager – Bridgwater, Somerset**
**Monday – Thursday 8:30am – 5pm, Fridays 8:30am – 4pm**
* Competitive pay
* 7% Employer pension contribution
* Personal healthcare cover with Bupa
* Life assurance
* 27 days holiday plus bank holidays
* Purchase extra holiday scheme
* Access to employee benefits platform – Cheers which includes flexible benefits such as; additional healthcare cover, healthcare cash plan, dental insurance, car scheme, activities pass, financial services, will writing services etc.
Reporting to the Factory Manager, you will have a key role working with the factory management team, with the specific remit around operational KPI’s, customer service, Health and Safety and Quality standards. Managing a team of Shift Managers you will ensure we deliver operational excellence across your factory production halls. The delivery will come through the application of continuous improvement techniques, employee engagement and living the company values ensuring you’re an exemplary leader at all times.
**About the role of Production Manager at Refresco Beverages:**
* The Production Manager is responsible for overseeing all aspects of production, fostering strong partnerships with both internal and external stakeholders.
* You will support the Factory Manager in setting and aligning site and departmental goals with the broader business strategy.
* Full accountability for managing the production budget, including labor and materials, will be yours, while ensuring optimal Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) through regular reviews and collaboration with sales, forecasting, and planning teams.
* You will report on KPIs (SQDCP), interpreting data, and developing action plans to drive performance. Ensuring the site’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are up-to-date, fit for purpose, and well-trained will be key, alongside maintaining audit readiness and compliance with the Quality Management System (QMS).
* You will manage staffing levels to ensure they meet demand and cost targets, while inspiring and motivating your team to meet their objectives. Leading continuous improvement initiatives to enhance OEE and yield, promoting health and safety practices, and fostering collaboration across departments are essential.
* You will manage and contribute to various site projects, define competency levels, and develop training programs to strengthen the team. Conducting annual appraisals, regular one-on-ones, and supporting Factory engagement programs will be part of your leadership duties, along with covering for the Factory Manager and ensuring continuity in key roles during shifts.
**About you:**
As an experienced Production Manager ideally in the food manufacturing industry you will be expected to have a strong background in overseeing and optimizing production processes within a fast-paced, quality-driven environment.
**Key experience required includes:**
* Ideally **Food Manufacturing Expertise:** A proven track record in the food production sector, with in-depth knowledge of industry-specific regulations (e.g., HACCP, GMP, food safety standards) and a strong understanding of food production processes.
* **Leadership and Team Management:** Significant experience in managing and motivating large teams, including supervisory roles, with a focus on performance management, training, and development. Ability to inspire and lead teams to meet production targets and ensure high levels of employee engagement.
* **Production Planning and Control:** Expertise in production planning, scheduling, and inventory management, with a solid understanding of supply chain and logistics. Ability to optimize production efficiency, reduce waste, and manage costs effectively.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Experience implementing continuous improvement initiatives, such as Lean or Six Sigma methodologies, to enhance operational efficiency, quality, and productivity.
* **Budget and Financial Management:** Strong financial acumen, with the ability to manage production budgets, monitor costs, and work to cost reduction targets while maintaining quality and compliance.
* **Health, Safety, and Compliance:** A deep understanding of health and safety regulations in a manufacturing setting, and experience ensuring compliance with legal and company standards, as well as leading safety initiatives across the production floor.
* **Problem Solving and Decision Making:** Proven ability to solve complex production issues quickly and effectively, ensuring minimal disruption to the production schedule.
* **Communication and Stakeholder Management:** Strong communication skills to work with cross-functional teams (sales, planning, quality assurance, etc.), and external suppliers or partners, ensuring smooth operations and alignment with business goals.
* **Technology and Automation:** Familiarity with modern production technologies, including automated systems, PLCs, and manufacturing software, to optimize processes and improve overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
* **Qualifications:** A relevant degree in food science, engineering, or a related field is often preferred, along with professional certifications in food safety or production management.

Die Refresco Deutschland GmbH mit Hauptsitz in Mönchengladbach gehört als Hersteller von Fruchtsäften und Erfrischungsgetränken für Industrie- und Handelskunden zu den führenden Anbietern von Getränkelösungen in Deutschland. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt deutschlandweit rund 1.600 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter an zehn Produktions- und zwei Verwaltungsstandorten. Kerngeschäfte sind die Herstellung von Handelsmarken für den Lebensmittelhandel sowie die Getränkeabfüllung für viele Markenunternehmen. Darüber hinaus produziert Refresco Deutschland namhafte Mineralwassermarken wie Fürst Bismarck, hella, Märkisch Kristall und St. Michaelis.
Das Unternehmen ist Teil der Refresco Gruppe, einem global unabhängigen Anbieter von Getränkelösungen für Handelsmarken und Marken mit mehr als 75 Standorten in Europa, Australien, den USA, Kanada und Mexiko. Die Refresco Gruppe mit ihrem zentralen Firmensitz in Rotterdam produziert jährlich ein Volumen von rund 14 Mrd. Litern und beschäftigt über 14,000 Mitarbeitende.

**Albert Heijn and Refresco make orange juice supply chain transparent**
**_Consumers can follow the route of their orange juice, using blockchain_**
**Zaandam, 20 September 2018 - Dutch supermarket chain Albert Heijn and Refresco have made transparent the supply chain of Albert Heijn's own brand of ambient orange juice, using blockchain technology to do so. Refresco supplies Albert Heijn with this juice, sourced from Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC)'s juice business. Never before have consumers been able to follow the chain of a product like orange juice in this way. They can see, via a QR code, which route the oranges have traveled up until the juice is in a bottle on the store shelf. With this complete traceability, the next step is taken in transparency for consumers.**
**Rotterdam, the Netherlands, February 8, 2019** - Refresco today announces it has acquired Cott's concentrate manufacturing business in Columbus, GA ("Cott Beverages LLC"). The transaction follows Refresco's acquisition of Cott's bottling business in January 2018 and includes the RCI International division, which Refresco has agreed to sell to RC Global Beverages Inc., a Holding Company whose vision is to actively develop branded beverages worldwide. Cott Beverages LLC is a leading developer and manufacturer of soft drink concentrates for bottlers in more than 70 countries.
Hans Roelofs, CEO Refresco: "We are pleased to add Cott's Columbus concentrate manufacturing facility to Refresco North America. It adds extensive innovation capabilities and skills and creates a global center of excellence for beverage concentrate manufacturing. It is a perfect fit with our business. We have decided to divest the RCI International branded activities and find an owner who can bring similar focus and continuity to this iconic brand. With RC Global Beverages Inc., we believe we have found an excellent match. The sale of Columbus from Cott to Refresco and the sale of the RCI International activities from Refresco to RC Global Beverages Inc. took place simultaneously."

Production line of plant-based milk
Recently, Refresco opened its brand-new and first ever European plant-based production line in Calvörde, Germany. This means Refresco enters a new beverage category: oat drinks.
_“The market for plant-based drinks has grown rapidly in recent years, and we believe this is a category where we as Refresco can play an important role,”_ explains Dieter Schulz, COO of Refresco Europe. In addition to producing beverages for categories such as carbonated soft drinks, fruit juices, and energy and sports drinks, expanding into plant-based beverages is a natural step for Refresco. The company is excited to be able to offer plant-based products to customers.
It is a unique production line for Refresco, as the company manages the entire production and delivery process starting from the fermentation process of the raw oats all the way up to the drink's packaging and final delivery. After 18 months of preparation, construction, and testing of the new line, production began late last year and has since successfully delivered plant-based products to retailers across the continent.

- A co-packer or contract manufacturer is tagged with the product types it states it makes for its clients.
- A marketplace's listings, a distributor's catalogue and an investor's portfolio companies are not the company's products.
- When two candidates have the same name, judge each by its own definition.

Return JSON: verdicts, one per candidate id given, in the same order, each with id, applies (true or false), confidence from 0 to 1 that your decision is right, and reason (one short sentence, for every verdict, saying which evidence decided it). When applies is true, also give quote (copied exactly from the evidence, the shortest span that names the product); when applies is false, set quote to null.

**Be part of something refreshing.**
At Refresco, we’re driven to be the world’s best independent bottler. We produce some of the nation’s favourite drinks for leading brands and retailers — and we’re growing fast. We’re now looking for an experienced and motivated **Area Process Manager** to join our high-performing Kegworth team.
**The Role**
As Area Process Manager, you’ll take ownership of performance across the Syrup Room and Ingredient Control areas — leading the way in safety, quality, hygiene, and yield.
You’re proactive, decisive, and performance-driven. You lead by example, think strategically, and take pride in delivering high standards across everything you do. You’re passionate about developing people and processes and thrive in a fast-paced, forward-thinking environment.
**Join Refresco and help shape the future of great-tasting drinks. Apply now and refresh your career.**
**About Refresco:**
Refresco is the global independent beverage solutions provider for Global, National and Emerging brands, and retailers with production in Europe, North America, and Australia. Refresco offers an extensive range of product and packaging combinations from juices to carbonated soft drinks and mineral waters in carton, PET, Aseptic PET, cans, and glass. Refresco continuously searches for new and alternative ways to improve the quality of its products and packaging combinations in line with consumer and customer demand, environmental responsibilities, and market demand.
Refresco is headquartered in Rotterdam, the Netherlands and has more than 13,500 employees. www.refresco.com.
Our drinks on every table. That's the Refresco vision. We’re a global business and currently produce 12 billion litres of soft drinks from 64 manufacturing plants in 12 countries and we’re only just getting started.
We’re the proud owners of six drinks manufacturing sites within the UK. Our UK business provides a great place to work for over 1,800 employees, who produce private label soft drinks and fruit juices for all the leading retailers. Whether it’s packed in cartons, bottles or cans, we ensure that our products are made to the highest quality standards. Our products get where they need to be when they need to get there to meet the needs of our high-profile customers.
Refresco believes that equal opportunity for all is fundamental to our company's values and all our applicants can expect fairness and transparency in our recruitment process.
Die Refresco Deutschland GmbH mit Hauptsitz in Mönchengladbach gehört als Hersteller von Fruchtsäften und Erfrischungsgetränken für Industrie- und Handelskunden zu den führenden Anbietern von Getränkelösungen in Deutschland. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt deutschlandweit rund 1.600 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter an zehn Produktions- und zwei Verwaltungsstandorten. Kerngeschäfte sind die Herstellung von Handelsmarken für den Lebensmittelhandel sowie die Getränkeabfüllung für viele Markenunternehmen. Darüber hinaus produziert Refresco Deutschland namhafte Mineralwassermarken wie Fürst Bismarck, hella, Märkisch Kristall und St. Michaelis.
Er is iets unieks aan Refresco. Je kent onze naam misschien niet, maar onze producten ken je zeker. **Zaandam, 20 September 2018 - Dutch supermarket chain Albert Heijn and Refresco have made transparent the supply chain of Albert Heijn's own brand of ambient orange juice, using blockchain technology to do so. Refresco supplies Albert Heijn with this juice, sourced from Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC)'s juice business. Never before have consumers been able to follow the chain of a product like orange juice in this way. Production line of plant-based milk
Recently, Refresco opened its brand-new and first ever European plant-based production line in Calvörde, Germany. This means Refresco enters a new beverage category: oat drinks.
_“The market for plant-based drinks has grown rapidly in recent years, and we believe this is a category where we as Refresco can play an important role,”_ explains Dieter Schulz, COO of Refresco Europe. In addition to producing beverages for categories such as carbonated soft drinks, fruit juices, and energy and sports drinks, expanding into plant-based beverages is a natural step for Refresco. The company is excited to be able to offer plant-based products to customers.
It is a unique production line for Refresco, as the company manages the entire production and delivery process starting from the fermentation process of the raw oats all the way up to the drink's packaging and final delivery. After 18 months of preparation, construction, and testing of the new line, production began late last year and has since successfully delivered plant-based products to retailers across the continent.

* Albert Heijn and Refresco make orange juice supply chain transparent
**Albert Heijn and Refresco make orange juice supply chain transparent**
**_Consumers can follow the route of their orange juice, using blockchain_**
**Zaandam, 20 September 2018 - Dutch supermarket chain Albert Heijn and Refresco have made transparent the supply chain of Albert Heijn's own brand of ambient orange juice, using blockchain technology to do so. Refresco supplies Albert Heijn with this juice, sourced from Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC)'s juice business. Never before have consumers been able to follow the chain of a product like orange juice in this way. They can see, via a QR code, which route the oranges have traveled up until the juice is in a bottle on the store shelf. With this complete traceability, the next step is taken in transparency for consumers.**
Marit van Egmond, Commercial Director Albert Heijn: 'We supply millions of customers with good food and drink on a daily basis. This brings with it a large responsibility, and we want to actively contribute to current themes in the world around us. We are making our products healthier, are working on reducing food waste and we look at how to reduce our impact on the environment. The importance of transparency in the supply chain continues to increase. We know all the steps in the supply chain of our products, to ensure they are produced with respect for people, animals and the environment. And we want to show these steps to our clients as well, be open and transparent'.
Albert Heijn has long-standing relationships with fixed producers and suppliers for its 11,000 Albert Heijn brand products. In some cases, a production process can be made transparent relatively easily, for example, with fruits and vegetables from the Netherlands. It is more difficult for other products because they have a longer chain or consist of multiple ingredients. By using blockchain, a technology that records every step in the chain, it is possible to show customers how and by whom these products are made.
Albert Heijn and Refresco are using blockchain for the first time with AH's ambient orange juice. The data from the steps in the production chain is linked and made transparent. The blockchain was developed in cooperation with Supply Chain Information Management (SIM), an expert in visualizing and providing continuous insight into chains via research and databases.
**Juicy details**
Via a QR code on the packaging, customers can follow the entire route that their orange juice has traveled before it ended up in their shopping basket. It starts in Brazil at the orange groves managed by LDC Juice, where the fruit is harvested. Among other things, the quality standards that LDC Juice has for food safety and sustainability are recorded there. The blockchain also contains information about the oranges themselves, including the harvest date range and degree of sweetness. Consumers can see these details in the chain and even send a compliment to the growers with the "Like2Farmer" functionality.
Maarten Kusters, Managing Director Refresco Benelux: 'This is a unique way of bringing together the grower, processor, bottler, retailer and consumer and making the entire process of fruit juice production traceable and transparent. We are pleased that we can make a contribution in this way as Albert Heijn's partner. Being the world's largest independent producer of juices and soft drinks, Refresco is committed to a sustainable fruit juice sector. We aim for 100% sustainably-sourced juice by 2030 in fruit juice products of our clients. In support of this ambition, we co-founded the Sustainable Juice Covenant last year, alongside other leading industry players.'
Murilo Parada, Head of LDC's Juice Platform: 'This project has been a great opportunity for LDC Juice to highlight the various steps in the juice journey in a transparent way. Seeing the details, from grove to bottle, helps consumers understand LDC's sustainable juice value chain. LDC completed the first agricultural commodity trade through blockchain in January 2018 and is convinced that there are tremendous opportunities by using the technology as an enabler of digital transformation.'
**Rainforest Alliance**
The farms in Brazil that grow oranges for AH's own-brand ambient orange juice, are managed by LDC Juice. These farms all have the Rainforest Alliance certification seal, a quality mark for the environment, nature preservation and working conditions for products from areas where rainforests grow.
Han de Groot, CEO of Rainforest Alliance: 'We congratulate Albert Heijn on introducing this orange juice for which Rainforest Alliance certified oranges were grown. It is good that so many consumers are able to enjoy orange juice that contributes to improving the environment and the future of orange grove keepers and their families. An ever-increasing number of consumers want to have information about where their food is from and how it's made, and it is therefore wonderful that Albert Heijn clients can follow the route of their orange juice. We encourage other parties to follow this example.'

Maintenance Apprentice
Refresco is dedicated to nurturing and advancing the future skilled trades workforce. This program is structured to enable the Maintenance Management Team to collaborate with local technical schools, existing employees, or newly recruited team members by providing advancement opportunities for individuals seeking to gain practical experience alongside classroom education that will develop and grow their career in the Maintenance field. Through this initiative, Refresco aims to bolster its presence in the skilled trades job market while helping individuals kick start their careers.
**Program Prerequisites:**
* The employee is required to uphold a positive standing with the company.
* Candidates must undergo an interview with the Maintenance Manager and successfully pass a written and hands-on prequalification test to assess their fundamental skills before entering the program.
* The Maintenance Manager will assess the interview and testing outcomes to gauge whether any fundamental training is required.
**Work Requirements:**
* Apprentices are required to work 40 hours per week during 1st shift hours.
* Apprentices are not considered to be job qualified in terms of Daily or Off-Day Overtime, or Departmental Job Bidding. Apprentices are eligible for all other fringes as outlined in the Collective Bargaining Agreement.
* Job specific training will be provided during the working hours of the apprentice. These trainings must be completed prior to advancing out of the program.
* Work quality and quantity will be regularly assessed by management. Reviews will be documented and provided to the apprentice on 30-day intervals throughout the duration of the program.
**Guidelines for the Apprentice:**
* Refresco and the Teamsters Union Local No. 688 generally recognize the maximum duration of the apprentice skillset as 18 months, any extension to this will be mutually agreed upon by the company and the union prior to any extension being granted.
* The company has the discretion to advance the Apprentice to the level of Maintenance Mechanic B at any time based on the results of the prequalification testing.

* EMT0110: Electrical Maintenance I
* FWL0110: Welding I
* INT0110: Industrial Maintenance Mechanics
* PLT0110: Pipefitting Theory and Practice

* Should fundamental training be required, it will be offsite and carried out by a local reputable technical college, approved vendor or the OEM.

* If the external training necessitates tools that are not included in the tuition fees, the company will cover the cost of the tools at its expense, contingent upon the apprentice's willingness to sign an additional 24-month commitment letter, thereby extending the total employment commitment to 48 months.
* Because the company is covering the cost of tuition, wages will not be paid for time spent in training.

* Meet Wilbert de Smit
Wilbert
Wilbert de Smit
Wilbert was the Head of Contract Manager for the Benelux when we interviewed him. He has since been promoted to Head of Business Development at Group level.
**I’m the head of Contract Manufacturing for the Benelux region, which means that I oversee production for brands - some household names, and some promising startups.**
This morning from my office, I can see a line of trucks outside the factory waiting to take a shipment of beer from the production line away for distribution. This never ceases to make me proud: it’s unusual in manufacturing to see so many products lines through from start to finish.
When I started here, for example, one of the first customers I signed was a soft-drinks start-up. By taking on the production, we helped take these guys from a tiny operation to a really well-known, well-distributed player within their sector. Although our part in this company’s growth isn’t obvious from the outside, we know that we’ve played our part, and we’ve been able to do so because we’re set up to move quickly, decisively and effectively.
We’re organized into business units, and decisions are taken within those units, so we don’t need twenty signatures to get something done. We don’t have to sit through countless conference calls. We sit down with a few people and act, fast.
Instead of producing the same product every day, we produce hundreds of different products for all kinds of customers. Right now we’re bottling beer. Soon it might be spirits or tonic water. It’s one thing to have motivational posters stating your company values, but we live ours. When we say we’re agile, we mean it and you don’t have to look far to find the evidence. It’s like changing the tires on your car. Done by yourself, at home, with the tools you stow in the trunk of your car, it’s likely to take a while. We’re the guys in the pits in Formula One. We’re set up to do it in seconds.
I feel a great deal of responsibility for what we do, and it’s difficult to hide if we aren’t performing at our best. I can trace a line between my contribution and the finished product so I can see exactly what value I’m bringing to the company. Some might find that kind of pressure scary, but if you find it motivating, it’s a really rewarding way to work.
That said, it’s pretty flexible. We don’t clock watch, we just get the work done. If you perform well, there’s room for flexibility. I travel for my job - not as much as I once did, but fairly regularly - and if I come off a plane at 3pm, I’m not necessarily expected to go back to the office. I’ll do what I need to do at home. I have four children, so it’s good to know that I can balance the long hours I’ll work when I’m on a deadline with earlier finishes, so I’m not a stranger at the dinner table at home.
I think most people want to feel that what they do matters and has an impact, whatever sector and whatever role they’re in. On days like today, when we’re watching a shipment come off the line, loaded up and driven away, I can really see how my contribution as Commercial Manager translates into results.
> It’s one thing to have motivational posters stating your company values, but we live ours.
— Wilbert de Smit, Head of Contract Manufacturing, Refresco Benelux

* Refresco Iberia awarded three Lean & Green stars
Refresco Iberia awarded three Lean & Green stars
large green star with words 'lean & green' in the center, and 3 smaller stars below it.
**We are thrilled to congratulate our colleagues in Refresco Iberia for achieving three Lean & Green stars for reducing over 35% of their transport emissions since 2020.**
Refresco Iberia’s achievement significantly supports one of our key focus areas in ESG: reduction of Greenhouse Gas Emissions across our supply chain and operations.
To achieve their third Lean & Green star, Refresco Iberia have reduced their transport-related GHG emissions by 36% compared to the 2025 baseline. Therefore, the third Lean & Green star is a testament for all the great work by the Refresco Iberia logistics team.
Their achievement comes from a combination of continued focus on optimized logistic processes and dedicated initiatives like servicing a specific transport route with one electric truck per day for a certain period, participating in the CHEP AirShare Community for Transport collaboration, using DUO-trailers from southern to central Spain, and more.
Refresco Iberia’s participation in the Lean & Green is a multi-year commitment that began with one star in 2020 and aims to achieve more than a 50% reduction of their transport emissions by 2030.
**ESG at Refresco**
ESG is integral to how we run our operations, serve our customers, and develop our people. It underpins our Buy and Build strategy, making it crucial to our ability to deliver profitable growth. Our ESG strategy therefore focuses on creating a positive impact in five key areas: workplace, greenhouse gas emissions, packaging, waste, and water. Each pillar structures various actions and initiatives which are embedded in our supplier and procurement engagement.
For more information on our ESG commitments, visit our ESG page.
**About Lean & Green**
Lean & Green is the largest European collaboration platform specifically aimed at reducing emissions associated with logistics – aiming to cut transport-related emissions in half by 2030. Born in the Netherlands, Lean & Green currently has a presence in 14 countries and more than 600 member companies around the globe.

* Refresco completes acquisition of Frías, enhancing Plant-Based beverage portfolio
**Press Release****Refresco completes acquisition of Frías, enhancing Plant-Based beverage portfolio**
**Rotterdam, The Netherlands, November 18, 2024** – Refresco, the global independent beverage solutions provider for retailers and global, national, and emerging (GNE) brands in Europe, North America, and Australia, today announces the successful closing of its acquisition of Frías Nutrición (“Frías”), a leading manufacturer of plant-based drinks in Spain. This transaction, first announced on July 22, 2024, strengthens Refresco’s position in the rapidly growing plant-based beverage category.
Frías, located in Burgos, Spain, employs approximately 250 people and specializes in producing private label plant-based drinks, including almond, rice, hazelnut, and soy options for key retailers in Spain and beyond. This acquisition complements Refresco’s existing operations in Spain and significantly expands its capabilities in the plant-based drinks sector.
“As part of our proven Buy & Build strategy, we are looking to expand our capabilities in existing and adjacent beverage categories. The acquisition of Frías not only enhances our footprint in the plant-based drinks market, but it also allows us to better serve our European customers and accelerates our product innovation capabilities. We are excited to welcome the talented Frías team and are dedicated to a seamless integration process that will drive mutual growth.”
With this acquisition, Refresco reaffirms its commitment to delivering high-quality, innovative beverage solutions to its customers, while also further enhancing its service offerings.
**Refresco is the global independent beverage solutions provider for retailers and global, national and emerging brands with production in Europe, North America and Australia. Refresco offers an extensive range of product and packaging combinations from juices to carbonated soft drinks and mineral waters in carton, PET, Aseptic PET, cans and glass. Refresco continuously searches for new and alternative ways to improve the quality of its products and packaging combinations in line with consumer and customer demand, environmental responsibilities and market demand. Refresco is headquartered in Rotterdam, the Netherlands and has more than 14,500 employees. www.refresco.com

**Be part of something refreshing.**
At Refresco, we’re driven to be the world’s best independent bottler. We produce some of the nation’s favourite drinks for leading brands and retailers — and we’re growing fast. We’re now looking for an experienced and motivated **Area Process Manager** to join our high-performing Kegworth team.
**The Role**
As Area Process Manager, you’ll take ownership of performance across the Syrup Room and Ingredient Control areas — leading the way in safety, quality, hygiene, and yield.
You’re proactive, decisive, and performance-driven. You lead by example, think strategically, and take pride in delivering high standards across everything you do. You’re passionate about developing people and processes and thrive in a fast-paced, forward-thinking environment.
**Join Refresco and help shape the future of great-tasting drinks. Apply now and refresh your career.**
**About Refresco:**
Refresco is the global independent beverage solutions provider for Global, National and Emerging brands, and retailers with production in Europe, North America, and Australia. Refresco offers an extensive range of product and packaging combinations from juices to carbonated soft drinks and mineral waters in carton, PET, Aseptic PET, cans, and glass. Refresco continuously searches for new and alternative ways to improve the quality of its products and packaging combinations in line with consumer and customer demand, environmental responsibilities, and market demand.
Refresco is headquartered in Rotterdam, the Netherlands and has more than 13,500 employees. www.refresco.com.
Our drinks on every table. That's the Refresco vision. We’re a global business and currently produce 12 billion litres of soft drinks from 64 manufacturing plants in 12 countries and we’re only just getting started.
We’re the proud owners of six drinks manufacturing sites within the UK. Our UK business provides a great place to work for over 1,800 employees, who produce private label soft drinks and fruit juices for all the leading retailers. Whether it’s packed in cartons, bottles or cans, we ensure that our products are made to the highest quality standards. Our products get where they need to be when they need to get there to meet the needs of our high-profile customers.
Refresco believes that equal opportunity for all is fundamental to our company's values and all our applicants can expect fairness and transparency in our recruitment process.

Das Unternehmen beschäftigt deutschlandweit rund 1.600 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter an zehn Produktions- und zwei Verwaltungsstandorten. **Albert Heijn and Refresco make orange juice supply chain transparent**
**_Consumers can follow the route of their orange juice, using blockchain_**
**Zaandam, 20 September 2018 - Dutch supermarket chain Albert Heijn and Refresco have made transparent the supply chain of Albert Heijn's own brand of ambient orange juice, using blockchain technology to do so. Refresco supplies Albert Heijn with this juice, sourced from Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC)'s juice business. Never before have consumers been able to follow the chain of a product like orange juice in this way. They can see, via a QR code, which route the oranges have traveled up until the juice is in a bottle on the store shelf. With this complete traceability, the next step is taken in transparency for consumers.**
**Rotterdam, the Netherlands, February 8, 2019** - Refresco today announces it has acquired Cott's concentrate manufacturing business in Columbus, GA ("Cott Beverages LLC"). The transaction follows Refresco's acquisition of Cott's bottling business in January 2018 and includes the RCI International division, which Refresco has agreed to sell to RC Global Beverages Inc., a Holding Company whose vision is to actively develop branded beverages worldwide. Cott Beverages LLC is a leading developer and manufacturer of soft drink concentrates for bottlers in more than 70 countries.
Hans Roelofs, CEO Refresco: "We are pleased to add Cott's Columbus concentrate manufacturing facility to Refresco North America. It adds extensive innovation capabilities and skills and creates a global center of excellence for beverage concentrate manufacturing. It is a perfect fit with our business. We have decided to divest the RCI International branded activities and find an owner who can bring similar focus and continuity to this iconic brand. With RC Global Beverages Inc., we believe we have found an excellent match. The sale of Columbus from Cott to Refresco and the sale of the RCI International activities from Refresco to RC Global Beverages Inc. took place simultaneously."
**CEO Refresco, Hans Roelofs commented:**
"We are pleased to report a good start to 2019. Our volume continued to develop favorably, driven by additional volume from the former Cott bottling business and organic growth. Additionally, I also get satisfaction from introducing and implementing new projects that affect the comfort of work. One of the last projects completed last year was the replacement of the pasteurizer on the aseptic line, which allows us to increase the quality of our products and extend the line's operating time. Let me just say that we celebrate our common successes with the entire team, which translates into trust in all of us."
> The trust given to me and my team makes us feel perceived as conscientious, reliable, and solid people.
Instead of producing the same product every day, we produce hundreds of different products for all kinds of customers. Right now we’re bottling beer. Soon it might be spirits or tonic water. It’s one thing to have motivational posters stating your company values, but we live ours. When we say we’re agile, we mean it and you don’t have to look far to find the evidence. It’s like changing the tires on your car. Done by yourself, at home, with the tools you stow in the trunk of your car, it’s likely to take a while. We’re the guys in the pits in Formula One. We’re set up to do it in seconds.
I feel a great deal of responsibility for what we do, and it’s difficult to hide if we aren’t performing at our best. I can trace a line between my contribution and the finished product so I can see exactly what value I’m bringing to the company. Some might find that kind of pressure scary, but if you find it motivating, it’s a really rewarding way to work.
“This marks a major milestone in our expansion strategy. The Grüneberg site not only offers premium water sources but also gives us direct access to the important Berlin/Brandenburg market. We are excited to officially welcome the experienced production team in Grüneberg and look forward to building on their expertise,” Guido Kühne, Managing Director of Refresco Deutschland, explains.
The Grüneberg site produces a range of water and soft drink products, and its integration into Refresco's Germany’s network further strengthens the company’s ability to meet customers’ demand for premium beverages across Germany. The acquisition aligns with Refresco’s broader Buy & Build strategy, reinforcing its position as a leader in providing beverage solutions to retailers and branded customers.

A category applies when the company makes, or offers to make, the product type the category describes. Read each candidate's definition; the name alone is not enough (for example "Italian" may be a dressing). Rules:

- Tag a product category only when the evidence names that product type. A capability sentence alone ("we fill beverages", "we offer co-packing") does not make every beverage category apply.
- Storage variants: claim a Frozen, Refrigerated or Shelf Stable category only if the evidence gives that storage state for that product (words like frozen, refrigerated, chilled, shelf-stable, ambient, or their equivalents in the site's language). If the product is named without a storage state, prefer the bare category when it is among the candidates.
- A co-packer or contract manufacturer is tagged with the product types it states it makes for its clients.
- A marketplace's listings, a distributor's catalogue and an investor's portfolio companies are not the company's products.
- When two candidates have the same name, judge each by its own definition.

Return JSON: verdicts, one per candidate id given, in the same order, each with id, applies (true or false), confidence from 0 to 1 that your decision is right, and reason (one short sentence, for every verdict, saying which evidence decided it). When applies is true, also give quote (copied exactly from the evidence, the shortest span that names the product); when applies is false, set quote to null.

**Be part of something refreshing.**
At Refresco, we’re driven to be the world’s best independent bottler. We produce some of the nation’s favourite drinks for leading brands and retailers — and we’re growing fast. We’re now looking for an experienced and motivated **Area Process Manager** to join our high-performing Kegworth team.
**The Role**
As Area Process Manager, you’ll take ownership of performance across the Syrup Room and Ingredient Control areas — leading the way in safety, quality, hygiene, and yield.
You’re proactive, decisive, and performance-driven. You lead by example, think strategically, and take pride in delivering high standards across everything you do. You’re passionate about developing people and processes and thrive in a fast-paced, forward-thinking environment.
**Join Refresco and help shape the future of great-tasting drinks. Apply now and refresh your career.**
**About Refresco:**
Refresco is the global independent beverage solutions provider for Global, National and Emerging brands, and retailers with production in Europe, North America, and Australia. Refresco offers an extensive range of product and packaging combinations from juices to carbonated soft drinks and mineral waters in carton, PET, Aseptic PET, cans, and glass. Refresco continuously searches for new and alternative ways to improve the quality of its products and packaging combinations in line with consumer and customer demand, environmental responsibilities, and market demand.
Refresco is headquartered in Rotterdam, the Netherlands and has more than 13,500 employees. www.refresco.com.
Our drinks on every table. That's the Refresco vision. We’re a global business and currently produce 12 billion litres of soft drinks from 64 manufacturing plants in 12 countries and we’re only just getting started.
We’re the proud owners of six drinks manufacturing sites within the UK. Our UK business provides a great place to work for over 1,800 employees, who produce private label soft drinks and fruit juices for all the leading retailers. Whether it’s packed in cartons, bottles or cans, we ensure that our products are made to the highest quality standards. Our products get where they need to be when they need to get there to meet the needs of our high-profile customers.
Refresco believes that equal opportunity for all is fundamental to our company's values and all our applicants can expect fairness and transparency in our recruitment process.
Die Refresco Deutschland GmbH mit Hauptsitz in Mönchengladbach gehört als Hersteller von Fruchtsäften und Erfrischungsgetränken für Industrie- und Handelskunden zu den führenden Anbietern von Getränkelösungen in Deutschland. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt deutschlandweit rund 1.600 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter an zehn Produktions- und zwei Verwaltungsstandorten. Kerngeschäfte sind die Herstellung von Handelsmarken für den Lebensmittelhandel sowie die Getränkeabfüllung für viele Markenunternehmen. Darüber hinaus produziert Refresco Deutschland namhafte Mineralwassermarken wie Fürst Bismarck, hella, Märkisch Kristall und St. Michaelis.

Wij zijn voortdurend op zoek naar de volgende uitdaging, verruimen onze horizon en laten ons bedrijf groeien. Daarom zijn we altijd op zoek naar mensen die ons team willen komen versterken in een van onze fabrieken of die een ondersteunende rol willen spelen in een van onze kantoren.

This fifth production line for Saint Alban will support their production capacity, provide new employment opportunities, and ensure Refresco France's growth thanks to an investment of 17 million euros. It will also enable Refresco France's capabilities in a new beverage category for them: beer!

**Albert Heijn and Refresco make orange juice supply chain transparent**
**_Consumers can follow the route of their orange juice, using blockchain_**
**Zaandam, 20 September 2018 - Dutch supermarket chain Albert Heijn and Refresco have made transparent the supply chain of Albert Heijn's own brand of ambient orange juice, using blockchain technology to do so. Refresco supplies Albert Heijn with this juice, sourced from Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC)'s juice business. Never before have consumers been able to follow the chain of a product like orange juice in this way. They can see, via a QR code, which route the oranges have traveled up until the juice is in a bottle on the store shelf. With this complete traceability, the next step is taken in transparency for consumers.**
**Rotterdam, the Netherlands, February 8, 2019** - Refresco today announces it has acquired Cott's concentrate manufacturing business in Columbus, GA ("Cott Beverages LLC"). The transaction follows Refresco's acquisition of Cott's bottling business in January 2018 and includes the RCI International division, which Refresco has agreed to sell to RC Global Beverages Inc., a Holding Company whose vision is to actively develop branded beverages worldwide. Cott Beverages LLC is a leading developer and manufacturer of soft drink concentrates for bottlers in more than 70 countries.
Hans Roelofs, CEO Refresco: "We are pleased to add Cott's Columbus concentrate manufacturing facility to Refresco North America. It adds extensive innovation capabilities and skills and creates a global center of excellence for beverage concentrate manufacturing. It is a perfect fit with our business. We have decided to divest the RCI International branded activities and find an owner who can bring similar focus and continuity to this iconic brand. With RC Global Beverages Inc., we believe we have found an excellent match. The sale of Columbus from Cott to Refresco and the sale of the RCI International activities from Refresco to RC Global Beverages Inc. took place simultaneously."
**CEO Refresco, Hans Roelofs commented:**
"We are pleased to report a good start to 2019. Our volume continued to develop favorably, driven by additional volume from the former Cott bottling business and organic growth. This reflects our 2018 investments in production capacity and the increased market demand, especially in contract manufacturing for our branded customers and non-alcoholic beverages in cans.
Gross profit margin per liter was up compared to last year: a combined effect of synergies, recovery of input cost increases, strengthening of the USD and GBP as well as a shift towards more value added products and services for our customers.
Arizona Production & Packaging is one of the fastest growing beverage manufacturing companies in the United States. From modest beginnings, AZPACK is now a major contract manufacturer in the Southwest, working with clients around the globe to support their bottling and canning needs. Managed by Co-Founders Peter Reilly and Dr. Yibing Wang, the company continues to pursue its original purpose: providing the finest beverages with uncompromising principles. AZPACK has a well-earned reputation of offering world-class manufacturing operations and responding quickly to customer requirements. AZPACK’s client list consists of Fortune 500 beverage companies, including makers of well-known energy drinks and nutrition and dietary supplements; they support a wide range of suppliers.

**Press Release****Refresco completes acquisition of Frías, enhancing Plant-Based beverage portfolio**
**Rotterdam, The Netherlands, November 18, 2024** – Refresco, the global independent beverage solutions provider for retailers and global, national, and emerging (GNE) brands in Europe, North America, and Australia, today announces the successful closing of its acquisition of Frías Nutrición (“Frías”), a leading manufacturer of plant-based drinks in Spain. This transaction, first announced on July 22, 2024, strengthens Refresco’s position in the rapidly growing plant-based beverage category.
Frías, located in Burgos, Spain, employs approximately 250 people and specializes in producing private label plant-based drinks, including almond, rice, hazelnut, and soy options for key retailers in Spain and beyond. This acquisition complements Refresco’s existing operations in Spain and significantly expands its capabilities in the plant-based drinks sector.

Refresco enters new beverage category in Europe: Plant-based Drinks
Production line of plant-based milk
Recently, Refresco opened its brand-new and first ever European plant-based production line in Calvörde, Germany. This means Refresco enters a new beverage category: oat drinks.
_“The market for plant-based drinks has grown rapidly in recent years, and we believe this is a category where we as Refresco can play an important role,”_ explains Dieter Schulz, COO of Refresco Europe. In addition to producing beverages for categories such as carbonated soft drinks, fruit juices, and energy and sports drinks, expanding into plant-based beverages is a natural step for Refresco. The company is excited to be able to offer plant-based products to customers.
It is a unique production line for Refresco, as the company manages the entire production and delivery process starting from the fermentation process of the raw oats all the way up to the drink's packaging and final delivery. After 18 months of preparation, construction, and testing of the new line, production began late last year and has since successfully delivered plant-based products to retailers across the continent.

- Keep one entry per product type; list a product once even if it appears many times.

Rotterdam, The Netherlands. – Refresco has reached a strategic agreement with PepsiCo for the production of part of the PepsiCo beverages volume in Spain effective 1 November 2019.
Refresco and PepsiCo are already partners in other European markets, including France, Belgium, Germany, and in the USA.
The agreement also involves the transfer of two of the three factories PepsiCo currently has in Spain: Tafalla (Navarra) and Seville. Both in a geographical and technological way, these production locations complement the current Refresco plants in Spain and provide Refresco with extra capacity for its growth in Spain.
PepsiCo will have a mixed supply model in Spain, since its third plant located in Echávarri Viña (Alava), which is also dedicated to the production of carbonated beverages, will continue to be a part of PepsiCo's operations, serving both Spain and other European markets thanks to its strategic location.
Victor Perez, PepsiCo's South West Europe Supply Chain Director, notes, "This new mixed supply model is key to our sustainable growth in the Spanish market. Refresco is a natural partner for PepsiCo as we successfully work together in other markets maintaining our high standards of quality and service”.
As Hans Roelofs, CEO Refresco Group, explains: ”This agreement is a very good extension of our relationship with one of our key customers, PepsiCo. It also confirms our business model in Spain, serving retailers and contract manufacturing customers".
\*\*\*\*\*\* end of press release \*\*\*\*\*\*

Rotterdam, the Netherlands – March 26, 2020. Refresco provides an update to Bond holders on its current business in light of the Coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic.
**Operational update**
Refresco continuously monitors the rapidly changing developments regarding COVID-19 and its potential impact on all areas of our business across Europe and North America. Our priority is to keep our employees safe and healthy, while continuing to serve our customers.

While we see more challenges arising in our supply chain, we have been able to manage the demand of our customers and have resolved most issues by implementing alternative solutions, in line with our business continuity plans.
**Market developments**
Volumes produced for retailers have increased in all our geographies since the outbreak of COVID-19. Volumes for contract manufacturing have shown a downward trend, mainly in products for out of home consumption - which is a relatively small category for Refresco.
**Financial update**
We confirm that our financial performance over the first quarter 2020 is in line with our expectations. Volumes have slightly increased. This is partially offset by a change in product mix, and by a slight increase in costs mainly as a result of higher handling costs.
Our cash position continues to be strong and we are in a comfortable financial position.
Refresco will publish its Q1 2020 results on May 14, 2020.
Overall, our business is resilient with a strong company culture of agility and entrepreneurship, and a solid business model aimed at long-term growth. Privacy
Pursuing the goals of Refresco requires the processing of personal data. When processing such data, we are required to comply with the applicable laws and regulations. That goes for personal data pertaining to ‘you’ as our (potential) customer, consumer, prospect, job applicant, visitor of our plant(s) and business partner (supplier, agent or advisor). In the context of this Privacy Policy you and other natural persons of which we process personal data will be referred to as ‘external contacts’.
This Privacy Policy describes the personal data that Refresco collects from or about you, and how we use and to whom we disclose that personal data.
**Application and scope of this Privacy Policy**
This Privacy Policy applies to the personal data of all of our external contacts.
**Organizations covered by this Privacy Policy**
This Privacy Policy applies to Refresco, its parent company and its subsidiaries and other affiliated entities. All references in this Privacy Policy to Refresco", "we", "us", "our" and like terms should be interpreted accordingly.
It is Refresco’s policy to comply with the privacy legislation within each jurisdiction in which we operate. Sometimes the privacy legislation and / or an individual's right to privacy are different from one jurisdiction to another. If you are unsure if or how this Privacy Policy applies to you, please contact HR.
**What is personal data?**
Personal data is any information about an identifiable individual. Personal information does not include anonymous or non-personal information (i.e., information that cannot be associated with or tracked back to a specific individual).
**What personal data do we process?**
In our business operation we process different types of personal data of our external contacts, including, but not limited to, the personal data contained in:
* completed contact forms;
* submitted complaints;
* communications, via post, e-mail, phone, websites or social media platforms;
* job application letters;
* the books in which names and signatures of visitors of our factories are recorded;
* public sources (such as the Commercial Trade Registers);
* databases from third parties, including recruitment agencies;
* supplier and/or customer events organized by Refresco.
In addition to the examples listed above, personal data also includes information such as gender, date of birth, education and/or training details, bank details and any other information necessary to achieve Refresco’s business purposes, which is disclosed in the context of having contact or doing business with, or applying for a job at, Refresco.
Furthermore, in addition to the examples listed above personal data can also be processed in case Refresco’s Speak Up Policy is used. For further information about our Speak Up Policy and what concerns are covered by this policy, we refer to the Speak Up Policy.
As a general rule, Refresco processes personal data directly provided by external contacts. **Albert Heijn and Refresco make orange juice supply chain transparent**
**_Consumers can follow the route of their orange juice, using blockchain_**
**Zaandam, 20 September 2018 - Dutch supermarket chain Albert Heijn and Refresco have made transparent the supply chain of Albert Heijn's own brand of ambient orange juice, using blockchain technology to do so. Refresco supplies Albert Heijn with this juice, sourced from Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC)'s juice business. Never before have consumers been able to follow the chain of a product like orange juice in this way. They can see, via a QR code, which route the oranges have traveled up until the juice is in a bottle on the store shelf. With this complete traceability, the next step is taken in transparency for consumers.**
**Rotterdam, the Netherlands, February 8, 2019** - Refresco today announces it has acquired Cott's concentrate manufacturing business in Columbus, GA ("Cott Beverages LLC"). The transaction follows Refresco's acquisition of Cott's bottling business in January 2018 and includes the RCI International division, which Refresco has agreed to sell to RC Global Beverages Inc., a Holding Company whose vision is to actively develop branded beverages worldwide. Cott Beverages LLC is a leading developer and manufacturer of soft drink concentrates for bottlers in more than 70 countries.
Hans Roelofs, CEO Refresco: "We are pleased to add Cott's Columbus concentrate manufacturing facility to Refresco North America. It adds extensive innovation capabilities and skills and creates a global center of excellence for beverage concentrate manufacturing. It is a perfect fit with our business. We have decided to divest the RCI International branded activities and find an owner who can bring similar focus and continuity to this iconic brand. With RC Global Beverages Inc., we believe we have found an excellent match. The sale of Columbus from Cott to Refresco and the sale of the RCI International activities from Refresco to RC Global Beverages Inc. took place simultaneously."
**CEO Refresco, Hans Roelofs commented:**
"We are pleased to report a good start to 2019. Our volume continued to develop favorably, driven by additional volume from the former Cott bottling business and organic growth. This reflects our 2018 investments in production capacity and the increased market demand, especially in contract manufacturing for our branded customers and non-alcoholic beverages in cans.
Gross profit margin per liter was up compared to last year: a combined effect of synergies, recovery of input cost increases, strengthening of the USD and GBP as well as a shift towards more value added products and services for our customers.

{"system":"You read text scraped from one company's website and extract what the company itself makes or can make. The text is a window of the site; other windows are read separately and merged later. Answer only from the text you are given.

Return JSON with:

- entity_type: what this company is, judged from this window alone. One of: manufacturer (makes its own branded products), co_packer (makes products for other brands: contract manufacturing, private label, co-packing, filling, bottling), both, marketplace (a platform listing products from many sellers), investor (a private equity fund or financial holding whose portfolio companies operate independently; an industrial group or parent company that owns operating brands, factories or subsidiaries making products is a manufacturer, and its subsidiaries' products are its products), distributor (resells other manufacturers' products), other. If this window has no signal about entity type, choose other.
- products: each product type this company makes or can make, as a short English name (2 to 5 words, no brand names, no sizes), with a quote copied exactly from the text that names it, and storage: frozen, refrigerated or shelf_stable only if a storage word (frozen, refrigerated, chilled, fresh, shelf-stable, ambient, or equivalents in the site's language) appears with that product, otherwise null.
- capabilities: manufacturing or packaging services offered (for example contract manufacturing, private label, hot fill, retort, aseptic filling, canning, blending, pouch filling), each with an exact quote.
- brands: brand names that belong to this company.
- site_language: the main language of the text (ISO 639-1 code).
- summary: one sentence on what the company is and does.

Rules:
- Products listed on a marketplace, sold by a distributor, or made by an investor's portfolio companies are not this company's products; leave products empty and set entity_type accordingly.
- A capability sentence such as "we fill beverages" is not a product unless the text names the product type (for example "we fill energy drinks and kombucha" names two products).
- Copy every quote exactly as written in the text, including its original language. Do not translate or paraphrase quotes. Product names are in English even when the quote is not.
- Do not invent products from a company name, a page title or an image caption alone unless it plainly names a product type.
- Keep one entry per product type; list a product once even if it appears many times.

Network Engineer
The IT Network Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, management, and optimization of the organization’s network infrastructure. This role ensures that all network systems, including LAN, WAN, wireless networks, and security solutions, are functioning efficiently, securely, and reliably to support business operations. The IT Network Engineer will monitor network performance, troubleshoot issues, implement new technologies, and work closely with other IT teams to enhance and secure network architecture. This position requires a deep understanding of networking technologies, protocols, and security measures.
**Essential Job Functions:**
Network Design & Implementation:
* Design, configure, and deploy LAN, WAN, and Wireless Networks, ensuring they meet business needs and performance standards.

* Implement network solutions to ensure scalability, redundancy, and high availability.
* Collaborate with IT teams and business stakeholders to identify network requirements and recommend solutions.
Network Management & Optimization:
* Monitor the performance of network systems, ensuring optimal throughput, uptime, and minimal latency.
* Perform proactive network capacity planning, including monitoring bandwidth usage and scaling the network infrastructure as needed.
* Optimize network performance through fine-tuning configurations, upgrading hardware, and implementing best practices.
* Manage routing, switching, and traffic management, ensuring efficient data flow across the network.
Network Security:
* Implement and manage network security solutions, including firewalls, VPNs, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), and network access control (NAC).
* Ensure the network is secure by applying security best practices, including encryption, access control, and threat mitigation strategies.
* Conduct regular network security assessments, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests to identify and address potential threats.
* Respond to and mitigate network security incidents, ensuring timely resolution and minimal impact on business operations.
Troubleshooting & Support:
* Diagnose and troubleshoot network issues, including outages, performance degradation, and connectivity problems.
* Provide Level 2/3 support for network-related incidents and escalate issues to the appropriate teams when necessary.
* Analyze network logs and monitoring data to identify trends, bottlenecks, and potential issues.
* Collaborate with other IT teams to resolve cross-functional problems affecting network performance.
Network Infrastructure Maintenance:
* Manage and maintain network hardware, including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, and load balancers.
* Apply firmware updates, patches, and configuration changes to ensure all network devices are up to date and secure.
* Schedule and perform regular network maintenance, minimizing downtime and ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
* Manage network inventory, tracking hardware assets and software licenses.
Wireless Network Management:
* Design, deploy, and manage wireless networks to ensure strong coverage, security, and optimal performance across all company locations.
* Implement wireless security protocols and guest access management to ensure controlled and secure access.
* Monitor and troubleshoot wireless network performance, ensuring minimal interference and optimal signal strength.
Vendor & Service Provider Management:
* Coordinate with external vendors, ISPs, and service providers to troubleshoot issues, request services, and ensure SLA compliance.
* Evaluate new network hardware, software, and services, making recommendations to senior management for procurement.
* Collaborate with vendors during network upgrades, migrations, or new implementations to ensure successful deployment.
Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity:
* Implement network redundancy, failover, and disaster recovery solutions to ensure business continuity in the event of network failures.
* Design and test backup and recovery processes to ensure that network configurations can be restored in a timely manner.
* Document and maintain disaster recovery procedures for the network infrastructure.
Compliance & Documentation:
* Ensure that the network infrastructure complies with regulatory and security standards, such as PCI-DSS, GDPR, or HIPAA.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of network configurations, processes, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Ensure adherence to change management procedures, minimizing risks associated with network changes.
**Required Skills:**

* Familiarity with network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios) and troubleshooting methods (e.g., packet capture analysis).
* Solid knowledge of network security principles, including firewalls, encryption, VPNs, IDS/IPS, and NAC.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure to resolve critical network issues.
* Familiarity with software-defined networking (SDN) and network automation tools.
* Knowledge of ITIL practices and experience with IT service management platforms.
Competencies:

* A proactive and self-motivated individual who can work both independently and collaboratively within a team.

* Refresco enters new beverage category in Europe: Plant-based Drinks
Refresco enters new beverage category in Europe: Plant-based Drinks
Production line of plant-based milk
Recently, Refresco opened its brand-new and first ever European plant-based production line in Calvörde, Germany. This means Refresco enters a new beverage category: oat drinks.
_“The market for plant-based drinks has grown rapidly in recent years, and we believe this is a category where we as Refresco can play an important role,”_ explains Dieter Schulz, COO of Refresco Europe. In addition to producing beverages for categories such as carbonated soft drinks, fruit juices, and energy and sports drinks, expanding into plant-based beverages is a natural step for Refresco. The company is excited to be able to offer plant-based products to customers.
It is a unique production line for Refresco, as the company manages the entire production and delivery process starting from the fermentation process of the raw oats all the way up to the drink's packaging and final delivery. After 18 months of preparation, construction, and testing of the new line, production began late last year and has since successfully delivered plant-based products to retailers across the continent.
###### **A Significant Milestone**
_“Building this state-of-the-art plant-based line was a strategic investment for us through which we now open a new product category for Refresco Germany and beyond. I see this new capability as an important future growth enabler for our business. Well done to our German team for the flawless execution of the project and for servicing our customers with plant-based products!”_ Dieter concludes.
Guido Kühne, Managing Director of Refresco Germany adds: _“This investment was the logical next step for Refresco Germany following the successful integration of HANSA-HEEMANN, a major German mineral water and CSD company that we acquired in 2021. It supports the German strategy to significantly build the co-manufacturing business and expand into new categories.”_
In addition to this dedicated production line in Germany, Refresco also has capabilities to produce almond-based beverages in North America.

**Albert Heijn and Refresco make orange juice supply chain transparent**
**_Consumers can follow the route of their orange juice, using blockchain_**
**Zaandam, 20 September 2018 - Dutch supermarket chain Albert Heijn and Refresco have made transparent the supply chain of Albert Heijn's own brand of ambient orange juice, using blockchain technology to do so. Refresco supplies Albert Heijn with this juice, sourced from Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC)'s juice business. Never before have consumers been able to follow the chain of a product like orange juice in this way. They can see, via a QR code, which route the oranges have traveled up until the juice is in a bottle on the store shelf. With this complete traceability, the next step is taken in transparency for consumers.**
**Rotterdam, the Netherlands, February 8, 2019** - Refresco today announces it has acquired Cott's concentrate manufacturing business in Columbus, GA ("Cott Beverages LLC"). The transaction follows Refresco's acquisition of Cott's bottling business in January 2018 and includes the RCI International division, which Refresco has agreed to sell to RC Global Beverages Inc., a Holding Company whose vision is to actively develop branded beverages worldwide. Cott Beverages LLC is a leading developer and manufacturer of soft drink concentrates for bottlers in more than 70 countries.

We have decided to divest the RCI International branded activities and find an owner who can bring similar focus and continuity to this iconic brand. With RC Global Beverages Inc., we believe we have found an excellent match. The sale of Columbus from Cott to Refresco and the sale of the RCI International activities from Refresco to RC Global Beverages Inc. took place simultaneously."

Recently, Refresco opened its brand-new and first ever European plant-based production line in Calvörde, Germany. This means Refresco enters a new beverage category: oat drinks.
_“The market for plant-based drinks has grown rapidly in recent years, and we believe this is a category where we as Refresco can play an important role,”_ explains Dieter Schulz, COO of Refresco Europe. In addition to producing beverages for categories such as carbonated soft drinks, fruit juices, and energy and sports drinks, expanding into plant-based beverages is a natural step for Refresco. The company is excited to be able to offer plant-based products to customers.
It is a unique production line for Refresco, as the company manages the entire production and delivery process starting from the fermentation process of the raw oats all the way up to the drink's packaging and final delivery. After 18 months of preparation, construction, and testing of the new line, production began late last year and has since successfully delivered plant-based products to retailers across the continent.
